brief: A planter for a sunny kitchen windowsill with three herbs growing in it.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Single-cell hex bin planter (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3, full depth) compact for windowsill, narrow footprint ~177mm, with soil-filled compartments. Suitable for sunny sill placement.
Three compartments planted: basil-young (prop:1), mint-young (prop:2), parsley-young (prop:3) each in separate soil surfaces f1/f2/f3 with soil fill.

finish.summary: Compact single-cell planter with 3-compartment bin, soil-filled and planted with basil, mint and parsley — visible and correctly placed for a sunny kitchen windowsill.

events.text: Your sunny windowsill herb planter — I'll build it with three herbs ready to grow.
